map.truba.name: The Pipe
npc.sanitar.name: The Medic
npc.rodion.name: Rodion "Little Key" Uglov
dialog.prolog_smotritel.start: Water's running — the Dam's opened the outfall. Move it, you've dived before.
dialog.prolog_smotritel.choice.yazyk: [Language 5] Don't teach the teacher — I'll figure it out myself, no hand-holding.
dialog.prolog_smotritel.choice.default: Got it. Heading to the grate.
dialog.prolog_smotritel.choice.tupoy: Water. It's wet. I remember from last time.
dialog.prolog_vybor.start: The key… take it. I'm drowning!
dialog.prolog_vybor.choice.klyuch: Take the key and let the current have him.
dialog.prolog_vybor.spas_end: You… owe me now. Rodion, from the Dam. Won't forget it.
dialog.prolog_vybor.klyuch_end: The key's yours. Rodion gets dragged under the grate — and he's gone.
dialog.prolog_kruchok.start: Attention on the line: Vedeneyev requested more power for the Institute. Again.
dialog.prolog_kruchok.title: Chapter 1. The Pipe.
